summary: Specifies the Internet Storage Name Service (iSNS), a protocol that helps iSNS clients and servers discover, manage and configure iSCSI and Fibre Channel devices on an IP network. It provides discovery services comparable to those in Fibre Channel networks. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: A school directory tells you where each class is. iSNS is a directory for storage devices on a network, so computers can find the disks they need.
